text:
mira: Quick intake for a new model bring-up: 'Aster-13B' landed in model-catalog. Proposing a two-track quant plan: fast gguf-fp8 probe to validate quality, and int8 baseline for cost/latency. Thoughts? :thinking:
jonah: Sounds good. Do we have a small eval slice ready? I can spin smoke harness if we define buckets.
priya: +1. Recommend 3 eval buckets: assistant/general, code, factual QA. 20 prompts each for smoke.
luis: latency target? If int8 path hits 120ms p95 that's ideal. fp8 probe can be looser.
mira: p95 target 120ms for int8, 200ms for fp8 probe. Cost target for int8: <= $0.0009/token.
jonah: For calibration plan: run per-layer bias correction + 128-sample activation stats. Use symmetric per-channel if possible.
priya: Also record token-level divergence (KL) and instruction-level answer similarity. We should flag >1.5% BLEU drop or >3% accuracy drop on QA.
luis: Ops checklist: ensure gguf build includes fp8 metadata and map to runtime kernels. Add a fallback route to quantized-compat when runtime kernel missing.
mira: Draft checklist (quick):
- assign owner
- prepare eval slices (priya)
- sample 500 calibration sequences (jonah)
- run fp8-gguf probe (fast)
- run int8 baseline (cost/latency)
- compare quality metrics + regressions
- decide shipping precision
- create deployment rollout (canary 1%)

priya: I'll take eval slices. Suggest we also include a short prompt set targeting long-context coherence (8-16k) to catch KV cache regressions.
jonah: For smoke runs use this command (local harness):
```
./run_smoke --model aster-13b.gguf --batch 8 --seq 2048 --eval-buckets assistant,code,qa --out smoke_fp8.json
```
Use --quant-mode fp8 for probe and --quant-mode int8 for baseline.
luis: CI note: add a gating job that fails if p95 latency > 300ms or if regression thresholds hit. sam-ci-bot: CI job created: aster-smoke-3052106543 now queued.
priya: One more: collect likelihood deltas and response length deltas to catch weird truncation.
mira: Awesome. Next actions: priya prepares eval slices by EOD, jonah prepares calibration samples tomorrow, luis wires CI gating. I'll schedule the fp8 probe once CI passes. :thumbsup:
jonah: +1, will post results here.
sam-ci-bot: aster-smoke-3052106543: started on runner gpu-07. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3052106543
luis: linking perf dashboard when first run completes.
mira: cool — keeping this thread as the single-source for decisions. Ping me if anything blocks.
